members.title: 33 天年收入从 100 万美金涨到 200 万美金，AI浏览器Aside 做对了什么
members.content: 你有没有想过，为什么那么多 AI 代理号称能替你办事，真用起来却总卡在第一步？不是让你先登录，就是说“这个我做不了”，要么就是要你先把十几个软件一个个接进来。今年 7 月，OpenAI 关掉了自己的 AI 浏览器 ChatGPT Atlas，把网页代理的功能收回到 ChatGPT 的桌面应用里，很多人一度觉得 AI 浏览器这条路走不通了。 可就在这个月 13 号，一家叫 Aside 的公司的 CEO Jun Kim 在 X 上发了一条帖子：产品上线四个月，年收入突破 200 万美元，月活 15 万，从 100 万美元涨到 200 万美元只用了 33 天。他说，他们在证明浏览器是“工作代理”最好的形态。Aside 是 YC 2025 年秋季批次的公司，三位创始人来自韩国，他们进 YC 的时候做的根本不是浏览器，而是一个帮销售在电话会议上“作弊”的助手。这篇想顺着他们自己讲的经历，看看这个浏览器是怎么来的，以及它为什么能在 Atlas 关门的同一年跑起来。 Aside 官网首页，写着“最聪明的 AI 助手，但它是一个浏览器”，下面是它正在替人取消订阅、申请退款。图片来自 Aside 官网 01申请了七次才进 YC，进去以后做的是一个销售会议助手 Aside 的联合创始人 Chanhee 今年 7 月在 X 上写过一篇长文，讲他们为什么转型，题目叫《再见 YC Cluely》。

members.title: 办公Agent的 "人头税"，被LobsterAI改变了
members.content: 事情是这样的。 最近，我在公司干了一件事，给团队找AI。缘由很简单，有同事问AI账单能不能报销？我了解发现，每个人用的AI产品不一样，账单多少也不一样？不仅对账麻烦，月底还可能超支。 最关键的是，如果员工自行购买AI，将核心信息上传到各种各样的Agent上，公司的安全性可能受到威胁。 于是，我想着开个办公Agent企业版，既能控预算还方便管理。看来看去，门槛还真不低。业内的普遍定价约 200 元/⼈/⽉，一年的最低费用=200 × 12 × 团队人数。 更关键的是，Agent还有积分额度限制。有的员⼯不够⽤，还要再单独买额度包；有的员⼯没怎么用，积分月底要清零。这不仅增大了投入，还会导致积分浪费。 在体验了多个办公Agent企业版后，我终于找到适合小企业小团队的产品，它就是LobsterAI 团队版，可以说是20人以内高效团队的办公Agent首选。 一、LobsterAI 有哪些优势？ LobsterAI 是网易旗下的办公Agent。 LobsterAI 团队版最⼤的优势是0席位费，300元即可开通，积分365天有效。 这意味着，小企业、小团队可以以极低的⻔槛，为团队引⼊⼀款 Agent，⽤多少买多少，积分 365 天有效，可以最⼤程度上避免浪费。 管理员可以为每个团队成员分配积分、查看每个人的⽤量、还可以根据使用情况随时调整积分额度。

topic_dossiers.topic_title: OpenAI与Meta联手发布个人代理协议Poppy

members.title: OpenAI 和 Meta 联手，打通了 Agent 商业「最后一公里」
members.content: Agent 能进门了，也能付钱了。 Agent 替用户「消费」的时代，终于到来了。 美国时间 2026 年 11 月 13 日，两家公司两场发布会同天发生。一边是企业级对话式智能体公司 Sierra 联合 Meta 正式发布个人代理协议 Poppy v1.0，解决助手怎么「进门」的问题；另一边是 OpenAI 推出面向个人助手 dots 的 ChatGPT Wallet，解决助手怎么「付钱」的问题。 同一天打通进门和结账，本身就足够耐人寻味。更值得留意的，是站在两套方案背后的同一批名字。Visa 和 Mastercard 同时出现在两边的名单里，Shopify、Stripe 这些掌管电商与支付基础设施的公司，则站在 Poppy 的核心伙伴之列。 Agent 的下一场竞争，表面上看是巨头抢入口，底层的暗线却是一场围绕商业通道的提前占位。 个人 Agent 协议，PPP Sierra 与 Meta 联合发布个人代理协议 Poppy v1.0｜图片来源：Sierra 官方博客 过去，个人助手访问企业网站只能像个隐身访客，商家看不清来者是谁，更不敢把查订单、改地址、订机票或金融预审这类敏感操作交给它。 Meta 和 Sierra 推出的Poppy 要解决的核心就是信任，它让企业在接到请求时，能用密码学手段确认三件事——来敲门的是哪个助手、它代表哪位用户、到底拿了多少权限。

members.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
members.content: Outsiders had little reason to notice when Nvidia’s longtime chief security officer and head of product security stepped down in August. Just two and a half months later, CEO Jensen Huang himself left the company over growing questions about his extramarital relationships — starting with an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore data center company that U.S. investigators suspect of funneling Nvidia chips to China, then widening to reports about two separate affairs with Nvidia employees.

members.title: Should an AI agent sign this payment? I’ve released SRA-RiskGate-4B v2. It’s a 4B model fine-tuned from Qwen3-4B-Instruct that answers approve, hold or reject for stablecoin payments made by agents (x402, EIP-3009, Circle), and it settles payment disputes. On 2,000 held-out benchmark cases: ✅ 99.6% of payment decisions correct (base model: 59.8%) ✅ 0.35% unsafe approvals (base model: 34.6%) ✅ 90.2% of dispute outcomes correct, up from 77.8% in v1 The main change in v2: the dispute window is computed in code and passed into the prompt instead of asking a 4B model to subtract dates. Wrongful denials fell from 26% to 2.1%. I also tested it on 227 real USDC payments from Base mainnet: it blocked none of the 151 real payments and approved none of the risky ones. The model isn’t the security boundary. The open-source checks in pip install sra-riskgate run first and fail closed, with optional Chainalysis, TRM, Range and Webacy screening. These are my own numbers. Every prediction is public, so you can re-score them. 🤖 Model: hf.co/sriram1983007/SRA-RiskGate-4B 🎮 Try to trick it: hf.co/spaces/sriram1983007/sra-riskgate-demo 📊 Benchmark: hf.co/datasets/sriram1983007/sra-stablecoin-risk-bench 🧾 Real payments: hf.co/datasets/sriram1983007/sra-real

members.title: AI撞上美国“新世界”：暴跌、监管、政治博弈，数据中心何去何从？
members.content: 美股中期选举之后，AI叙事改变，导致股市崩盘。 民主党赢得国会参众两院控制权后，市场担心，接下来对数据中心建设和AI安全的监管将进一步收紧。11月5日，纳斯达克100指数与费城半导体指数双双创下2020年3月以来最大单日跌幅。 而让人们更担心的是，这会是AI叙事的正式转变吗？ 过去，数据中心能否按时建成，主要看电够不够、设备能否交付。现在，企业还要回答另一组问题：电网升级由谁出钱，居民增加的水电费由谁承担，社区能获得多少长期就业？在一些地区，只要条件达不到，项目就可能被一票否决。在这次对话中，我们的嘉宾估计，在较坏的情况下，数据中心的成本可能增加10%至20%。 但建设受阻，并不等于算力需求消失。如果需求仍然旺盛，已经拥有算力的公司，反而可能获得更强的定价权。华尔街究竟是在担心机房建不起来，还是企业不再愿意为AI花钱？这两种判断，会带来完全不同的结果。 与此同时，许多美国当地居民关心的，是更具体的生活：房租还能不能负担，电费会不会上涨，建设结束后，工作岗位能留下多少。正如济容投资CEO兼CIO Bruce在对话中反复提醒的：“不要低估选民对这件事的反对。” 本篇文章，我们和能源策略和数据中心建设一线的从业者，以及长期追踪美股AI硬件板块的华尔街投资人聊了聊，政策变化将怎样影响建设、成本、融资与算力需求。我们也采访了三位美国当地居民，听他们讲述公投、住房和社区生活背后的诉求。

members.title: This AI Tamagotchi Turns Everyday Objects Into Needy Virtual Pets
members.content: You forgot to water the plant. Instead of seeing yellowing leaves, you see a cute plant-shaped pet on a tiny screen, looking sad and dejected. Maybe that'll give you the push you needed to grab the watering can. As you pour water into the soil, the plant pet on the screen gets excited and happy.That's the idea behind OATs, or Object Agent Twins—micro-agent AI avatars on tiny E Ink displays designed to pair with everyday household objects. The tech was created by Daehwa Kim, a fifth-year PhD student in Carnegie Mellon's Future Interfaces Group.

members.title: 大肥鱼 × 闲置掌机：手搓一台物理按键全屋AI终端
members.content: 最近不是闹鱼灾嘛，我也来蹭蹭大肥鱼热度，把大肥鱼塞进掌机，用来聊天和联动全屋智能。 这其实是我之前做过的一个掌上 AI 搭子，角色原先是“电玩元气少女”，但设定确实不如大肥鱼有意思。 于是我就把外观立绘和UI彻底重绘成了蓝色大肥鱼，顺便在NAS端搭了一套长期记忆系统，做成现在这套： 顶部微动岛，说话的时候，波形跳动，AI回复也在这呈现。中间左侧卡片是大肥鱼立绘，呈现多个姿态，待机、聆听、说话、记录等等。中间右侧是工作台。待办、速记、家居、音乐卡片可以选择。实体键做了专门映射：长按L1输入语音，松开停止；双击R1录音，再双击停止；长按R1输入碎碎念，AI整理成笔记；B键强制打断AI语音或动作；X同步NAS数据 米家设备也加入联动：摄像头、家庭屏、扫地机、温湿度计 大肥鱼数据存放在NAS，掌机和飞书共用一个大脑。 掌机是芒米Air Y Pro，骁龙865、8GB内存，带一块4:3屏幕、扬声器、降噪麦、双摇杆RGB灯带和一整套实体微动按键，root还很方便。 我一直觉得它太适合用来改一台随身物理AI终端了，像市面上最常见的是Codex Micro、哈基米Dock那种桌面小工具，但我已经有类似的了，所以就想着不如彻底榨干掌机的机械微动按键，做点不一样的。

members.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
members.content: Abstract SO-Arena evaluates System One models across domains and capability families, revealing that scaling and reasoning gains vary and that high overall accuracy does not ensure reliable decision-making. System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions.

members.title: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
members.content: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, and its registration pipelines are usually picked on feature-matching benchmarks where only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together can pull the robust homography toward their own motion (consensus capture), while inlier counts and ratios still look normal. We measure this with a two-part benchmark: Static: ten pipelines scored under exactly known homographies on 4K aerial frames, with tuning on a site-disjoint split.

members.title: TurtLES: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Turbulent 3D Neural PDE Surrogates
members.content: Published on Nov 6 Authors: , , Abstract Machine-learning surrogates are increasingly used to accelerate computational fluid dynamics, yet progress is limited by the lack of benchmarks capturing realistic, time-dependent turbulent flows. We introduce TurtLES, a 14 TB dataset of 3D turbulent cylinder wakes in the shear-layer transition regime, computed via high-fidelity implicit large-eddy simulations. The dataset contains 400 trajectories of 400 time steps each, with 3-11 million points per frame, spanning variations in geometry, Reynolds number, and angle of attack.

members.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
members.content: Published on Nov 5 Authors: , , , , , , , , , , Abstract Exposing benchmark success criteria to self-improving embodied coding agents can raise measured success under those criteria without improving instructed-task completion, and the advantage weakens under slight criteria changes and transfers poorly across tasks, while instruction-faithful criteria better reflect instructed-task performance. Self-improving embodied agents are increasingly being developed and compared on robot simulation benchmarks.

members.title: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
members.content: Published on Nov 11 Authors: , , , , Abstract Recent work suggests that pretrained image generators encode real-world understanding beyond image synthesis. Vision Banana exploits this by framing vision tasks as conditional image editing. However, its data, weights, code, and implementation details are not public. We present Open Vision Banana (OVB), a fully open and reproducible recipe for converting pretrained generators into unified multi-task perception systems.

members.title: A Cross-Scenario Survey and Analysis of Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
members.content: Published on Nov 10 Authors: Abstract A survey analyzes why self-improvement mechanisms for multimodal agents transfer unevenly across reasoning, generation, navigation, and manipulation scenarios, framing them as trade-offs over scarce factors and task-structural resources. Recent work shows that multimodal agents increasingly self-improve without recurring human annotation. However, each self-improvement mechanism is designed and evaluated within a single scenario, leaving its preconditions unverified under cross-scenario transfer.
